title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0036521182092 (+8.315456e-7 over #7644) with 74 erasures
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This construction raises the conservative conditional bound from **0.0036512866636 to 0.0036521182092** with the original 74 ordered erasures and the same signed 17-call caller as [#7644](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7644). The difference between the published bounds is **+0.0000008315456** (about **0.022774%**).

Role 46 travels directly from chart 513 to 127. The original path visited 914 and 245. An entrance sequence of 22 ADDs and two SCALEs, plus three later ADDs, preserves the intermediate private observations. #7644’s edits to roles 82 and 185 are retained. Across all 17 invocations the paid counts change by −34 at rank 1, −17 at rank 4 and +17 at rank 6. Total paid positions fall from **110,332 to 110,298** with the same **22,461** productive fields. For each invocation, strict subadditivity gives `6^t < 4^t + 1^t + 1^t` for every `0 < t < 1`. The fixed-invoice crossing is approximately 0.003652118209307584843, about 1.076 × 10⁻¹³ above the conservative claim.

## Task and overlap

Refined revision 8 card `p104-side-correction` from main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Source #7644 at `32cfa1d20d3e4587dc601e69ccac1cd24a239e5c`, word `86bc8a1d1276c5b8d80a19704f90279e85b24b9490a02b9afa67c1a5b119c114`. Candidate word `6c52b2fba7c20343a50cb92ed4b997aa9921c78f212ac6428d13fff2bcd014cf`. [Scoped Discussion claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19690974).

[#7611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7611) supplied the joint repair on a changed CLEAR-content interface. [#7616](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7616) ported a wider family and qualified a 113-lifetime successor. This package isolates the role-46 change on the exact #7644 word and qualifies its original 74-erasure application. [#7642](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7642) covered the final hop, and [#7643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7643) addresses roles 134/329. The larger figure in [#7641](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7641) uses 234 lifetimes and an additional common-U premise. [Bounded findings on that route](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19691406).

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-original74-main46-on7644
```

* Two exact scalar checks matched 1,501 arbitrary-input public rows, all 630 retained private/COPY observations and all 74 ordered erasures. The independently written interpreter rejected a wrong-sign correction at output 145, input 36.
* The native replay covered 2,958 chart pairs at 104 ports. Its detailed checks covered 58 affected pairs and four route compositions with 512 forward and 512 adjoint columns, including absolute phase. All 21 native rejection controls passed.
* The signed application checked 3,043 fresh catalogue maps and 104 main boundary pairs with signed Pauli action and exact global phase, plus 54 strict and four functional outer conditions. The ordinary bound was 782,645,968. Precision factor 2,430 and finite tape counts are in the packaged result. Directed decimal and dyadic invoice calculations agree.
* The registered offline command ran to completion on Linux with Python 3.12.3 in 939.20 seconds, with 663,928 KiB peak RSS. Its fresh native and signed stages passed. A relocated run of the optional independent checker matched all 24 stable fields of its original result in 47.53 seconds.

Review the [literal edit and proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32abeefff4d5fcc378ab3de1c1a8bf1c37737bdd/research/p104-original74-main46-on7644/PROOF.md), [complete signed result](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32abeefff4d5fcc378ab3de1c1a8bf1c37737bdd/research/p104-original74-main46-on7644/evidence/FINAL.json) and [portable independent checker](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32abeefff4d5fcc378ab3de1c1a8bf1c37737bdd/research/p104-original74-main46-on7644/independent/README.md).

## Credit

DreamingOfClouds supplied the joint correction (#7611, `bbdbc8aea2f4fd94a927f6d8c438372c0c69ae6c`), SYLforge the wider W1/W2 port (#7616, `22b310ba50a554b6111804824782793beb41073f`), ToikY the #7644 baseline, Ali Romman the original protected #7605 application, and Rohan Arun the #7113 signed caller. Clear1nsight prepared this source-bound port, verification and packaging with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. ChatGPT Pro assisted the separate #7641 search. Original licenses and notices are retained.

## CI prerequisite

The first [hosted plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44185826861/job/134401959146) stopped in the shared CI navigation test before the package replay. A separate commit carries [ToikY’s published CI repair from #7643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/694667c8c129508d78b53a6a51690d4c284d0549). It points the CI guide to the already-selected #7000 and runs the historical replay against its original snapshot and rejection controls. All five file blobs match ToikY’s repair. All six navigation tests passed locally. The construction commit and the CI prerequisite have the same 41-file package tree, `c4e25871096fe621edf72fc9f75459e1bbe734bc`.

The [next hosted job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44187293472/job/134410025509) exposed an empty PID file in the package’s source-free process-cleanup test. Commit `8ee7e6869b57ce445dbebd1d720366eab1f8ca40` fixes the writer with a same-directory atomic rename and keeps the group leader unreaped until cleanup. Delaying the writer reproduced the failure on the previous head. The revised control passed the delayed-write case, an early parent exit with child termination, and 24 ordinary repetitions. This commit changes only the control and its README. The constructor, both word digests, pricing code and all mathematical verifiers retain their reviewed bytes. [Final-head workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44189450326).

## Open next questions

The bound inherits five framework assumptions covering all-column operators and spectators, owned erasure, the uniform compiler, precision and fixed-tape tariffs, and analytic integer recovery. A maintainer can review the literal edits, emulator controls, resource bills and source-bound caller before considering admission. The package is confined to its research directory.
